hooks.command: AGENTS_MD="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)/AGENTS.md"; if [ -f "$AGENTS_MD" ]; then jq -Rs '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"SessionStart",additionalContext: ("# AGENTS.md - project rules (this project uses AGENTS.md instead of CLAUDE.md, so it is NOT auto-loaded like a normal CLAUDE.md would be; read it in FULL below before any code change in this repo). Rule 8 in particular requires KDoc + catalog (.claude/context) + skill (skill/mosaic*) + showroom (sample-server event_details/tile_details builders) to ALL be updated together, in the same task, for any Tile/Event change - no exceptions:\n\n" + .)}}' "$AGENTS_MD"; fi

python3 -c "
import sys, json
try:
    d = json.load(sys.stdin)
    f = d.get('tool_input', {}).get('file_path', '')
    patterns = ['Schema.kt', 'EventRunner.kt', 'TileRenderer.kt', 'Builder.kt']
    if any(p in f for p in patterns):
        print('REMINDER (Rule 8): You modified a Schema, EventRunner, TileRenderer, or Builder file.')
        print('Update the corresponding catalog in .claude/context/ before finishing:')
        print('  - *Schema.kt       → tiles-catalog.md or events-catalog.md')
        print('  - *EventRunner.kt  → events-catalog.md (implementation status)')
        print('  - *TileRenderer.kt → tiles-catalog.md (implementation status)')
        print('  - *Builder.kt      → no catalog update needed unless new schema fields')
except Exception:
    pass
"
